info.description:
Ready-to-go Retrieval-Augmented Generation service: ingest documents, search them, ask questions.

**Versioning.** This document describes `/v1`. The same routes without the prefix still work as
**deprecated aliases** (responses carry `Deprecation: true`); build new clients on `/v1`.

**Authentication.** `Authorization: Bearer <access token>` (from `POST /v1/auth/login`) or an API key in
`X-API-Key` (service accounts, see `POST /v1/api-keys`). Disabled only when `AUTH_ENABLED=false`.

**Errors.** Every error is `{"detail", "code", "request_id"}`; `code` is stable and machine-readable.
Every response carries `X-Request-ID` (send your own to correlate).
info.title: rag-pipeline

post.description:
Creates a non-interactive credential bound to an existing role. **The `key` in the response is the only time the secret is ever available**; only its SHA-256 is stored. Send it as `X-API-Key: <key>` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

The key's permissions are the role's permissions, read on every request, minus the management permissions (`users:manage`, `roles:manage`, `apikeys:manage`), which keys never hold. You can only bind a role whose permissions you hold yourself. Binding the `admin` role is allowed but returns a warning.

Example response: `{"id": "...", "name": "billing-service", "prefix": "k3j9x0aa", "key": "rag_k3j9x0aa_<43 random characters>", "status": "active", ...}`

post.description:
Create a document from a link and queue its ingestion (`202`-style: returns immediately).

The API only **validates** the link (scheme allow-list `URL_INGEST_SCHEMES`, no embedded
credentials, SSRF check: the host is resolved and every address must be public). The
**download happens in the worker**, with a streaming size cap (`URL_INGEST_MAX_BYTES`),
timeouts, redirect re-validation and file-type checks; then the normal parse/chunk/embed
pipeline runs. Poll `GET /jobs/{job.id}`: `stats.source_url` (query string removed) and
`stats.bytes_downloaded` appear once the file is fetched; `error` explains failures.

The document's `filename` is provisional until the download finishes. Submitting a link that
was ingested before creates a **new** document - there is no de-duplication by URL.
`s3://bucket/key` reads with the server's S3 credentials and only from buckets listed in
`URL_INGEST_S3_BUCKETS` (default: `S3_BUCKET`).

post.description:
Ranked passages for a query, **without calling an LLM** (no LLM key needed; works when the LLM is down).

Uses exactly the retrieval path of `POST /chat` (same modes, filters, de-duplication and ranking), so for the
same query and options the results are the passages `/chat` would have cited, in the same order.

**Ordering guarantee.** `results` are hits only, sorted best first; `rank` is 1..n with no gaps. Neighbouring
chunks (`neighbors` > 0) are never mixed into `results`: they are listed under the hit they surround in
`results[].context` (document order, unscored, no ranks). `score` is mode-specific (see `score_kind`).

Errors: `422` invalid request, `503` retrieval backend unavailable or the keyword/vector index does not match
the configuration (the message names the fix), `401`/`403` missing credentials / the `search:use` permission.
